context: A senior trains a new hire on internal CMS rules
purpose: Teach: ペーパー/ポリシー/フレーム/ドライバー/転載/改行/文字数/全角

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: これがうちのCMSの編集ポリシーをまとめた資料だ。最初に目を通しておいてくれ。
lines.en: This is the document summarizing our CMS editorial policy. Go through it first.
lines.style: Calm senior tone, instructive but not condescending, professional workplace register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。ええと…基本はペーパーレスで、紙の資料は配らない方針なんですね。
lines.en: Yes. Um... so basically it's paperless, and we don't hand out printed materials, right?
lines.style: Slightly hesitant new hire, polite, processing information aloud carefully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そう。あと外部記事の無断転載は絶対NGだから、引用元は必ず明記して。
lines.en: Right. And unauthorized reposting of external articles is absolutely forbidden, so always cite sources.
lines.style: Firm warning tone, matter-of-fact, emphasizing the rule without sounding harsh.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。本文の文字数って、何か制限ありますか?
lines.en: Understood. Is there any limit on the body text's character count?
lines.style: Curious question from junior, businesslike and practical inquiry.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 見出しは三十字以内。本文は改行を入れて、一段落あたり長くなりすぎないようにね。
lines.en: Headlines within thirty characters. For the body, insert line breaks so paragraphs don't get too long.
lines.style: Clear instructional delivery, breaking rules down step by step for the trainee.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 数字とかアルファベットは半角ですか?それとも全角?
lines.en: Should numbers and alphabet letters be half-width? Or full-width?
lines.style: Detail-oriented follow-up question, eager to clarify formatting standards.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 原則半角。ただし固有名詞だけ全角を使う例外もある。あとデザインのフレームはテンプレから外さないこと。
lines.en: Half-width as a rule. But proper nouns are an exception where full-width is used. Also, don't deviate from the template frame.
lines.style: Layered explanation with caveat, senior conveying nuanced internal conventions.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解です。画像のアップロード用ドライバーって、もう僕のPCに入ってますか?
lines.en: Got it. Is the driver for image uploads already installed on my PC?
lines.style: Practical logistics question, mildly concerned about tool readiness for tasks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 入れといた。困ったら俺か田中さんに聞けばいい。最初は誰でも戸惑うから、焦らず慣れていこう。
lines.en: I installed it for you. If you get stuck, just ask me or Tanaka-san. Everyone struggles at first, so take your time getting used to it.
lines.style: Warm reassuring closer, senior shifting from strict to supportive mentor mode.
